# Keep one useful record

**Start with the [project record](/templates/project-record).** Copy its headings into your existing spec or link it from there. Keep one individual record and one shared group record; update the current step with short notes and evidence links.

| Need help with… | Use this |
| --- | --- |
| A clear task, stories and success checks | [Small specification guide](/process/specifications) |
| A fair work split and class walkthrough | [Collaboration and review](/process/collaboration) |
| Recording a problem, response and retest | [Small issue starter](/process/github-feedback) |
| Actual checks and honest limits | [Quality guide](/process/quality) |
| Optional professional materials | [Editable résumé outline](/career/resume#copy-this-one-page-outline), [GitHub](/career/github), [LinkedIn](/career/linkedin) |

A Studio receipt can link the same code and checks as a project review. Explain the current skill or decision rather than duplicating the report. Keep any posted lesson-specific issue, PR, learning and test requirements.

IS373's professional guides extend an existing portfolio; they do not create a new graded portfolio, reflection or additional project. Follow Canvas for actual assignments and deadlines. [See examples](/examples/) · [Find your next class](/course/schedule).
